# EcclesiaOS v1.0.49

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.49 improves password recovery presentation and makes reset-link delivery feedback accurate.

## Authentication and branding

- Redesigned the forgot-password page to match the branded login experience across desktop and responsive layouts.
- Added branded account-recovery messaging, responsive shell behavior, and development mail-mode guidance.
- Preserved generic responses for unknown accounts to prevent account enumeration.
- Surface password-reset transport failures instead of showing a misleading success message.

## Verification

- Password reset feature tests pass.
- Blade templates compile successfully.
